subject: SIG Pack: operator separation, rotation cadence and transport manifest request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaprod.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@novaprod.com
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: SIG packet: KMS/HSM operator separation + rotation window

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for taking time with our security team last week. As we prepare the SIG baseline for our procurement review, we need a concise evidence bundle focused on encryption key management and operator controls. Specifically, can you provide: 

- A one-page index that enumerates artifacts we can attach to the SIG (rotation logs, HSM attestation, separation-of-duties matrix).
- Operator shift/hand-off logs for the past 12 months (redacted IDs ok).
- A succinct statement of your key rotation cadence, emergency rekey procedures, and any automated eviction/TTL behavior for ephemeral keys.
- Confirmation on whether HSM seals / attestation have been performed in the last 18 months and the location of attestation reports.

We aim to include this in the SIG response by Friday. If you can send an initial index and ETA for the artifacts today or tomorrow that would help a lot.

Best,
Samir
Security Engineer, Novaprod

--
Note: we may share these artifacts with our auditors; redactions are fine for operator IDs.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaprod.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG packet: KMS/HSM operator separation + rotation window

Samir — thanks for the detailed ask. Attaching an evidence index as a starting point and a short rotation summary. Quick answers up front:

- Rotation cadence: customer-managed tenant keys: quarterly rotation suggested; system-managed tenant and service keys: rolling rotation per model/version deploys and weekly ephemeral eviction for session keys.
- Emergency rekey: documented playbook with signed timestamps; tie-breaking procedure with 2-person approval and escalation to on-call security.
- HSM attestation: latest attestation (third-party) completed 2027-10-14; we will point to the PDF in the index.

Attachments: kms-evidence-index-v1.0.pdf, rotation-window-summary-2023-2028.xlsx, operator-separation-matrix.csv

I'll follow up with the operator shift logs export. We will redact personal identifiers per your note, and provide a mapping table for role IDs. Planning to deliver the logs and a short narrative by tomorrow EOD PST.

If Novaprod's auditors need direct read access to an artifact location, we can provision a time-limited GCS url.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)

Attachment stubs: kms-evidence-index-v1.0.pdf (10 pages index + checklist), rotation-window-summary-2023-2028.xlsx (spreadsheet), operator-separation-matrix.csv (CSV)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaprod.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG packet: KMS/HSM operator separation + rotation window

Samir — adding a couple of clarifications from ops so the artifacts map cleanly to SIG questions:  

1) Operator shift logs: we will provide an export that includes UTC timestamp, shift_id, role (HSM_operator, KMS_admin, Backup_operator), and action type (initiate_wrap, unseal, rotate_key, export_index). We will redact operator email/employee IDs and instead provide role hashes.

2) Separation of duties: the matrix lists which roles require 2-person approval (e.g., emergency unseal, key escrow release). This is enforcement in both our on-prem HSM workflow and cloud KMS bridging.

3) Transport manifest: our manifest shows transport method for key backups (S3 with server-side encryption + double-encrypted wrap) and a chain-of-custody ledger for any offline media. If Novaprod needs a checksum/CVE scan for the transport package, let us know.

We will also include a short runbook excerpt showing the TTL/eviction policy for ephemeral session keys used by inference caches. That typically covers the SIG "ephemeral key lifecycle" question.

Plan: final artifacts (redacted logs + manifest + index) to Samir by Thu 8 Nov 18:00 PST. If that timeline doesn't work for your audit window, tell us and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Key Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment notes: operator-separation-matrix.csv contains role->approval mapping; rotation spreadsheet includes historical rekey timestamps and impacted key IDs.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: delivery confirmation + custodian for sharing

Looping back internally — Samir received the index and rotation summary. Marissa, please deliver the redacted shift logs and transport manifest links as planned and copy security@novaprod.com. Use the time-limited signed URL for the bucket and mark expiry for 7 days. Karthik, suggest we include the 2-person approval audit trace (ticket IDs) as an appendix to the operator matrix so auditors can tie role hashes to approvals without seeing PII.

I will be the internal custodian for any follow-up technical clarifications. If Novaprod requests the raw attestation report (non-redacted), escalate to legal and we'll use an NDA/controlled access pattern.

Thanks — Jonas
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
